title: Second-Order Kubo Extension — Finite Second-Order Null Replay (Binding)
verdict_rationale: Manual differentiation confirms the displayed C recurrence and quotient-rule expression for kubo₂ under the note's midpoint-field convention. The runner's measured branch instead constructs node fields and averages their endpoint values inside prop_beam, so its finite differences correspond to g_e = −ikL·(1/r_i+1/r_j)/2 rather than the analytic g_e = −ikL/r_mid; the central residual comparison therefore mismatches observables. Moreover, equal 15/44 counts do not establish the stronger statement that no formerly failing family entered the subset, because the runner never compares membership, and the packet clips a declared load-bearing first-order authority. The negative boundary is thus only a failed finite stretch attempt: higher orders, alternate basepoints, nonperturbative treatments, and a corrected field-discretization route remain open; the pathology labels are not independent closure walls, and no hidden-admission, prior-residual, rhetoric-resolution, partial-closure, steelman, or cross-cycle evidence closes these defects.
